Counting intervals resample plates; final BBBC039 images share plates with development images.
B04-B07 were run using original post-processing settings and do not validate the later v2 settings.

decisions.observation: A03 shares groups for all held-out types, covering 1813 of 2397 test predictions.
decisions.hypothesis: Group-independent transfer to unseen types not established
decisions.next_action: Exclude held-out type and its groups; report each type and remaining training support.

decisions.observation: X01 5x5 beats whole by 0.0342 with exploratory group interval excluding zero, but its small-photo AUC is 0.5267 versus 0.7407.
decisions.hypothesis: Patch benefit supported on large formats; universal input support rejected
decisions.changed_decision: Provisional lead, preserve whole-image fallback candidate
decisions.next_action: Test scale-aware or whole-image handling of small images, otherwise require manual review for this format.

decisions.quality: Paired group bootstrap of saved development predictions
decisions.changed_decision: Retain both for final development selection
decisions.next_action: Compare worst-format performance, review curves and measured runtime before freezing one.

decisions.observation: B02 and B03-v2 count beat B01 in paired plate bootstrap; B03-v2 minus B02 interval crosses zero.
decisions.quality: Saved per-image errors re-scored; one training seed
decisions.hypothesis: Both improve this benchmark; counting superiority between them unresolved
decisions.changed_decision: Retain both as candidates rather than choosing by 0.23 count gap
decisions.next_action: Repeat training with new seeds and run exact retained settings on stress and outside-data checks.

decisions.observation: B03-v2 counting setting gives MAE 4.68 / F1@0.75 0.872; outline setting gives 9.86 / 0.891.
decisions.quality: Direct saved results and per-image checks
decisions.hypothesis: Best count and best outline values are not one configuration
decisions.next_action: Choose or expose explicit modes before final validation.

decisions.observation: B05 B02 count detection is 45.22% at overlap 0.50 and 32.17% at overlap 0.75 for the smallest tenth.
decisions.hypothesis: Weakness remains; stated 0.50 number in original report is wrong
decisions.changed_decision: Correct overlap label in subsequent claims
decisions.next_action: Refresh small-object curves using retained model settings.

decisions.observation: B07 original B02 counting model has grey-image MAE 48.84 versus B03 original outline 9.56 and B01 outline 11.16. Colour F1 approaches zero.
decisions.quality: Stored external-data scores; original settings only
decisions.hypothesis: Benchmark-best B02 is not a general outside-data solution
decisions.changed_decision: Keep B01 and B03 as distinct comparison/backup candidates; restrict colour inputs
decisions.next_action: Repeat outside-data evaluation using exact retained v2 settings before choosing a guard.

decisions.observation: A05 has a small positive paired development gain; training transformations do not change the inference path.
decisions.quality: Saved predictions re-scored; many variants tried
decisions.changed_decision: Do not discard solely as too small; lower priority than validity fixes
decisions.next_action: Confirm after core repairs if resources permit.

decisions.observation: All 36 IDs appear but C04 and F01-F04 have no completed performance result and some substeps remain pending.
decisions.hypothesis: Rejects claiming the full original plan is complete
decisions.next_action: Finish selection, confirmation and delivery gates with bounded claims.

decisions.observation: C03 chooses the central depth using the real fluorescent target; all five retained planes depend on that selection. The reference object masks are produced automatically from fluorescence.
decisions.quality: Direct inspection of c03_prep.py and c03_translate.py
decisions.hypothesis: Does not establish input-only plane selection or independent true-count validation
decisions.changed_decision: Reopen C03 deployment/generalization gate; retain original numbers only with target-assisted-selection and reference-mask limitations
decisions.next_action: Select planes from the plain input alone or a fixed acquisition rule, rebuild data and rerun both routes.

decisions.observation: C02 calls rng.permutation(tr_batches)[:4] inside the candidate-strength loop. Candidates can use different training batch subsets.
decisions.hypothesis: The chosen strength is not supported by a fully matched inner comparison; this alone is not final-test leakage
decisions.next_action: Compare every candidate on the same complete eligible training batches, then rerun held-out evaluation.

decisions.observation: The approved A02 plan already includes light retraining, while inspected A02/X01 results use frozen features.
decisions.quality: Approved plan plus saved configurations and code
decisions.hypothesis: Retraining benefit remains unmeasured; patches alone do not prove it
decisions.changed_decision: Move a controlled retraining comparison forward after validity repair
decisions.next_action: Compare frozen versus light retraining on matching development groups with resource measurements and worst-format checks.
